Here’s what changed in `style.css`:

### Dark theme
- **Page background**: Deep violet-tinted charcoal (`#12101a`) with a soft **medium purple** radial glow at the top so it doesn’t feel flat.
- **Text**: Light lavender-white body copy; **muted** copy in a desaturated purple-gray.

### Medium purple accents
- **Links**: `#9b7ed6`, brightening to `#b89ef0` on hover (replacing the old blue).
- **Borders & cards**: Purple-tinted borders; gallery cards use a slightly lifted **surface** (`#221d32`) with subtle purple edge highlights on hover.

### Structure
- CSS **custom properties** on `:root` (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--accent`, etc.) so you can tweak the purple or contrast in one place.

If you want the purple stronger (more saturated) or the background lighter/darker, say which direction and we can nudge the variables.
